title.en: Proven progress in dog obedience skills

text.en: Reviewers emphasize noticeable behavioral gains, including improved recall, leash manners, and decreased leash reactivity. Clients appreciate the structured weekly curriculum and find the accompanying online recap videos helpful for reinforcement at home.

Owners highlight trainers like Andre, Ethan, and Luca for their patience, clear instructions, and positive reinforcement techniques. While one reviewer felt group classes lacked individual attention, the vast majority commend the staff's ongoing dedication.

Pet parents note that trainers excel at putting excitable, shy, or newly adopted rescue dogs at ease during class. Handlers structure exercises and puppy socials to prevent overwhelm, helping puppies build genuine social confidence around other breeds.

q.en: What types of training classes are held at Dundas West?

a.en: The location hosts Puppy Start Right, Foundation Skills modules, loose leash walking, recall clinics, and puppy socials.

q.en: Are online video resources provided to students?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that class summaries and demonstration videos are accessible through student forums to assist homework practice.

q.en: Does the school help with leash reactivity?

a.en: Reviewers report that dedicated one-on-one sessions and targeted foundation classes effectively reduce canine reactivity.

q.en: What training philosophy does When Hounds Fly adhere to?

a.en: The academy practices modern, force-free, clicker-based positive reinforcement training.
